listing.name: Kirby Air Ride — Dragoon (lunchbox-recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental Kirby Air Ride source project. Upstream reports eight courses running past the countdown with blank cards; Nebula Belt remains locked. Other modes, setup and gameplay have not been confirmed by Portcove.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GKYE01 disc in ISO, CISO or GCM form. Convert RVZ or GCZ files first, following upstream instructions.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build locally from source with CMake and your own disc. The build fetches the pinned SDL3 version; follow upstream setup for the remaining tools.

warnings: Upstream reports eight Air Ride courses running past the countdown with blank cards. Nebula Belt remains locked, and other modes have not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
